description: This file defines the Currency model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for accessing and modifying currency data in the database, such as updating currency values, retrieving currency details by ID or code, and fetching all active currencies.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A model class for operations related to currencies within the Opencart catalog localisation module.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the value of a currency identified by its code and clears the currency cache.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record from the database by its code, only if the currency is active.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Fetches all active currencies from the database, caching the results for efficiency.
